place_structures.place_structure_verbatim: xa1=z1 is better than z2 for xa2 by standard xa3, by amount z4.
place_structures.mapping_reason: jbovlaste glosses this lujvo "better ; by the standard of goodness"; it is the xamgu+zmadu compound, i.e. the direct comparative of good. Notes mark xauzma as the canonical form, xagmau as the form in use.

place_structures.place_structure_verbatim: xa1=m1 is worse than/not as good as m2 for xa2 by standard xa3, by amount m4.
place_structures.mapping_reason: jbovlaste glosses this lujvo "worse ; by the standard of goodness"; xamgu+mleca compound, the direct comparative antonym of xagmau.

place_structures.place_structure_verbatim: t1=x1 is the best among set/range t4 for x2 by standard x3.
place_structures.mapping_reason: jbovlaste glosses this entry "best ; surpassing all others" / "superlative in goodness"; it is the xamgu+traji (goodness-superlative) lujvo. The same entry carries a second definition glossed "optimal" (see "optimal").

place_structures.place_structure_verbatim: t1=x1 is the worst among set/range t4 for x2 by standard x3.
place_structures.mapping_reason: jbovlaste glosses this lujvo "worst" (xlali+traji, badness-superlative), mirror image of xagrai.

place_structures.place_structure_verbatim: x1 fits/matches/suits/is compatible/appropriate/corresponds to/with x2 in property/aspect x3.
place_structures.mapping_reason: No valsi is glossed "appropriate" in jbovlaste; mapti's definition itself contains "appropriate" and its fit/suit/match sense covers appropriateness of x1 for x2 in aspect x3.

place_structures.place_structure_verbatim: x1 exceeds/is more than x2 in property/quantity x3 (ka/ni) by amount/excess x4.
place_structures.mapping_reason: In the judgment sense, "x1 is superior to x2 in respect x3" is the exceeds-relation; jbovlaste's "superior" gloss entries are anatomical only (claco'uklo, claco'umau), so zmadu is the fitting gismu.

place_structures.place_structure_verbatim: b1 is low/inferior/abject in property b2 (ka) by standard b3.
place_structures.mapping_reason: jbovlaste glosses this lujvo "inferior" directly (to'e+banli, the opposite of great).

place_structures.place_structure_verbatim: x1 exceeds/is more than x2 in property/quantity x3 (ka/ni) by amount/excess x4.
place_structures.mapping_reason: jbovlaste keys the gloss "more" to zmadu; it is the base comparative gismu (more than x2 in property x3 by margin x4).

place_structures.place_structure_verbatim: x1 is less than x2 in property/quantity x3 (ka/ni) by amount x4.
place_structures.mapping_reason: jbovlaste keys the gloss "less" to mleca; it is zmadu's direct antonym.

place_structures.place_structure_verbatim: x1 exceeds/is more than x2 in property/quantity x3 (ka/ni) by amount/excess x4.
place_structures.mapping_reason: No valsi is glossed "greater" in jbovlaste; "greater than x2 in property x3" is the zmadu relation (same wordslot as "more").

place_structures.place_structure_verbatim: z1 is smaller than z2 in dimension c2 by margin z4.
place_structures.mapping_reason: jbovlaste glosses this lujvo "smaller" directly (cmalu+zmadu).

place_structures.place_structure_verbatim: t1=x1 is optimal in property t2 of extremity t3 among range t4.
place_structures.mapping_reason: jbovlaste's second definition of xagrai is glossed "best ; optimal" and "optimal"; the xamgu+traji compound covers optimum-as-best directly.

No valsi is glossed or keyworded "efficient"/"efficiency": the jbovlaste English gloss index has no entry and the keyword lookup returns nothing for either term; no gismu expresses efficiency. tadji (method) and pilno (use) were considered and rejected — neither is an efficiency predicate.

place_structures.place_structure_verbatim: x1 [force] (ka) forces/compels event x2 to occur; x1 determines property x2 to manifest.
place_structures.mapping_reason: bapli is the only valsi carrying the official gloss "effective". The sense is narrow — an effective/compelling force that makes x2 happen (notes: "requires success") — not general "produces the intended result". Reported as the best available, flagged as a sense mismatch.

place_structures.place_structure_verbatim: x1 (person) is kind to x2 in actions/behavior x3.
place_structures.mapping_reason: jbovlaste's "warm" glosses are all temperature senses (mligla, kufygla, glare); no gismu is glossed "warm" in the emotive sense. xendo (kind in behavior) is the nearest interpersonal-warmth gismu.

jbovlaste's "cold" glosses are temperature (lenku, tolkuflenku) or illness (zuKAM); nothing covers the emotive sense. A tolxendo (unkind) record exists but carries no English definition, so there is no quotable place structure. Not invented.

place_structures.place_structure_verbatim: x1 is/acts as a friend of/to x2 (experiencer); x2 befriends x1.
place_structures.mapping_reason: No valsi is glossed "friendly"; pendo is the base friend predicate and its "acts as a friend" phrasing covers friendly behavior.

place_structures.place_structure_verbatim: x1 feels/is aggressive/hostile/antagonistic towards x2
place_structures.mapping_reason: jbovlaste glosses this lujvo "aggressive/hostile/antagonistic" — the hostile feeling itself, matching the emotive class.

place_structures.place_structure_verbatim: x1 feels/is aggressive/hostile/antagonistic towards x2
place_structures.mapping_reason: Same jbovlaste entry as "hostile"; its notes state it denotes feeling the emotions associated with attacking, unlike gunta which is the active attack — hence it fits the emotive class.

place_structures.place_structure_verbatim: x1 (person) pities/feels sorry for x2 (person) about x3 (abstraction).
place_structures.mapping_reason: No valsi is glossed "compassionate"; kecti (pities/feels sorry for) is the compassion gismu.

place_structures.place_structure_verbatim: x1 is secure/safe from threat x2 (event).
place_structures.mapping_reason: jbovlaste glosses snura "safe ; secure"; the threat-from-which place (x2) matches the fear-class slot exactly.

place_structures.place_structure_verbatim: x1 is perilous/dangerous/potentially harmful to x2 under conditions x3.
place_structures.mapping_reason: No valsi is glossed "dangerous"; ckape's definition itself contains "dangerous" (perilous/potentially harmful to x2), the exact sense.

place_structures.place_structure_verbatim: x1 threatens x2 with x3 (danger, peril).
place_structures.mapping_reason: Closest attested threat predicate in jbovlaste. It is agentive ("threatens"), not the threat itself; no gismu has the form "x1 is a threat to x2" — that role exists only as a place of other predicates (snura x2, bandu x3, ckape). Flagged as a role mismatch.

No valsi is glossed or keyworded "imminent" in jbovlaste. A bavlami record exists but carries no English definition, so nothing quotable; balvi is bare temporal ordering (future of x2), not imminence. Not invented.

place_structures.place_structure_verbatim: x1 is near/close to/approximates x2 in property/quantity x3 (ka/ni).
place_structures.mapping_reason: jbovlaste keys the gloss "near" to jibni; the base gismu for proximity in property/quantity x3.
